name: User Collections for WooCommerce
author: Greyforest

sections.description:
User Collections for WooCommerce is a plugin that enhances both the admin and customer experience. It lets store owners quickly view what products each customer has purchased, including full product histories and totals. On the front end, it provides admins the ability to display collections for customers to see their owned items neatly displayed as a visual collection page.

Perfect for record labels, art shops, niche fandoms, and any store or membership model where collecting products is part of the culture.

As an admin, this tool helps you understand customer tastes better and quickly see their purchased items.

For a consumer, this plugin makes it easy to see and explore a full collection of purchased items.

Shortcode

  • Displays a grid layout of product thumbnails and titles showing everything the currently logged-in customer owns.
  • Custom messages for users not logged in and users without a purchase.
  • Lets admin output user collections in custom location via shortcode in theme file or via block.
  • [ucforwc_collection]

Admin Dashboard

  • Adds a custom sub-menu under the WooCommerce dashboard.
  • Lists all store customers with purchase history.
  • Clicking a customer’s name reveals a detailed list of purchased products, including variations.
  • Displays a running tally of totals for each customer.
  • Lightweight and intuitive design for quick admin insights.

My Account

  • Adds a new “Collection” endpoint in the WooCommerce “My Account” menu (toggle on/off in settings).
  • Displays a grid layout of product thumbnails and titles showing everything the customer owns.
  • Lets customers browse their entire purchased product collection in one place.
  • Works well for membership and subscription sites by showing users exactly what they have access to.

Who Might Use This Plugin?

This plugin is ideal for:
– Record labels and music stores where fans build discographies.
– Art and collectibles shops where customers treasure their owned items.
– Niche ecommerce stores where collecting is encouraged or celebrated.

If you want to better understand your customers’ tastes—or give them a thoughtful free gift they don’t already have—User Collections for WooCommerce is the perfect addition to your store.

Icons made by https://www.flaticon.com/authors/srip from www.flaticon.com.

Support

If you have questions, need help, or just want to share feedback, I recommend using the Support tab on the WordPress.org plugin page. It’s the best way to reach out quickly and keep everything organized. I appreciate positive reviews if you liked this plugin or found it useful.

For general inquiries, you can also reach out at https://www.greyforest.digital/contact.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/user-collections-for-woocommerce directory, or install via the WordPress Plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > User Collections to access the admin list of customers and their purchased products.
  4. (Optional) Enable the Collection endpoint in the plugin settings to show the collection page on the customer “My Account” menu.
  5. (Optional) After enabling the Collection endpoint, you may need to flush the rewrite rules by visiting the Settings -> Permalinks page and clicking “Save Changes.”
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with variable products?

Yes! Variations are fully supported and counted in customer purchase histories.

Can I disable the front-end “Collection” page?

Absolutely. There’s a simple toggle in the plugin settings to enable/disable the front-end endpoint.

Will this slow down my store?

No. The plugin is intentionally lightweight and optimized to work efficiently with WooCommerce’s existing order and product data.

Can I customize the collection grid on the front end?

Yes, the collection page & shortcode output use simple naming conventions for a product grid, and all CSS can be easily customized via your theme or custom template overrides.

<div id="user-collection">
    <ul id="collection-products">
        <li class="collection-product">
            <a>
                <img>
            </a>
            <small>
        </li>
    </ul>
</div>
